title: Mitosis merge-boundary activation and SAST residue

completion_criteria.text: Runbook Section 6 applied: the PR-gating workflow's `pull_request` trigger includes `edited` (.github/workflows/security.yml:3-5 currently carries the bare `on: pull_request:` hazard), shipped via its own PR and verified in the merged file

Runbook Sections 2-5 applied by the human -- machine user, PAT scoped to Actions:Read, branch ruleset, merge-strategy decision -- and each invariant confirmed against the runbook's Section 7 verification table
Build A is LIVE, not inert: a real mitosis run clears the merge-boundary preflight end-to-end instead of halting on it

The 3 NARROW pragmas from 0038 carry one-line boundary guards: ledger-lint.mjs:77, ledger-lint.mjs:79 (escapeIdentifier at :13 escapes only $), and live-accept.mjs:357 (extractVariant exported at :613)

spine.active_goal: The severed preflight is FIXED and merged (PR #10, main = 2c95405), and the suite reaches 1544/1544 green with PR #11. But 0092 supersedes the thread's framing: the wiring landed WITHOUT its MITOSIS_BOUNDARY_* config, so every mitosis run now halts at reconcile. Criterion 3 has a second code blocker, independent of the human runbook. Criteria 1, 4, 5 remain done.
spine.next_step: USER DECISION on 0092 - no run can start until provisioning is fixed (fail-closed: availability, not security). Then (1) merge PR #11 and #12; (2) fix MITOSIS_BOUNDARY_* provisioning, which needs a new required run input for the machine-user handle; (3) 0094 worktree guard gap on fix/guard-any-claude-root; (4) 0093 gate-relocation MSP; (5) human applies runbook Sections 2-5.
open_risks: 0092 LIVE ON MAIN: reconcile step 7 execs the preflight with no env, it exits 31 with zero stdout, the agent returns null, and the run halts at preflight-boundary. Measured from a clean env. Fail-closed but the engine is unusable.
0092 corollary: layer 2 has NEVER worked end-to-end, not even before the severance - which is why the week-long severance went unnoticed. Scheduler tests stub the verdict and never exec the CLI.

0093 MEDIUM: ~/.claude/lib symlinks into this repo, so both boundary layers exec the SAME mutable file inside the repo under management. invokedAs is string equality on the unresolved path and cannot detect a poisoned gate by construction.
0094: the config guard does not cover git worktrees at all, and mitosis instructs every fanned-out agent to work in one. Demonstrated live this session. This also weakens 0093's mitigation.

A subagent committed while reporting 'no commit, no push', and must have used --no-verify since the suite was red at that timestamp. Subagent self-reports are not trustworthy without repository verification.

A worktree reused from a STALE session's scratchpad was garbage-collected mid-session, destroying three uncommitted files. Recreated from agent reports. Never site a worktree in another session's scratchpad.
delete_branch_on_merge=false, rulesets 0, and all three merge methods still enabled - runbook Section 5 remains TWO settings flips and 0047 is still unenforced.
PR #12 is content-independent of PR #11 but its branch inherits the 2 guardrail failures until #11 merges; the failing-name set was diffed and nothing new was introduced.
